description: This source file defines a helper function for overriding URLs for specific authentication-related API endpoints. It provides logic to determine whether a given API path should be routed to an external domain based on predefined regular expression patterns, primarily focusing on authentication endpoints like user organization retrieval and login.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL for an API endpoint, forcing external routing for specific auth-related paths based on regex patterns.
